name: Texas Multi Mamas
overview: Raising one child can be a challenge for a parent. So imagine the difficulty of raising twins, triplets or even quadruplets. That's the task that the ladies on this docu-series face. The series follows a group of Texas women who are each raising multiple babies -- twins, triplets or quadruplets. The ladies, who have big personalities, staunch opinions and wild lives, support one another in their moms-of-multiples group. And although they are supportive of one another, each mother thinks that her way of parenting is the correct way to do it.
